approach: Add a pure code_health module in athena-core: measure tracked .rs files (production lines cut at the #[cfg(test)] mod, longest fn via syn, 7-day landings and failure/rejection citations from records, suite time from the latest passing test CheckRun). Thresholds are constants. StatusView gets a code_health field and display::status renders an aligned table. An idempotent Athena::after_landing queues one structural-pass request per breaching file (marker-line dedupe) and a high-priority self-contained design-review request every 10 landings. The review baseline is anchored durably: the latest design-review-marked request if one exists; otherwise the first run of the hook commits a design-review baseline request-less marker record (a records file "code-health baseline" carrying the landed count) and later calls count from it. Hook is called at the end of land_pr (Landed) and in note_finished right after the Landed check, before the steward tick. Hook failures only warn.

decisions.choice: Anchor the first review baseline with a records-committed baseline marker written the first time the hook runs (landed count at that time), via Committer::commit_records; the baseline is the later of the latest design-review request and this marker.
decisions.reason: Survives state loss (lives in records), never fires on pre-existing history, and unlike a recomputed 'current count' it persists so landings after it accumulate to 10 (answers finding 1).

rejected.option: Baseline = current landed count recomputed each call
rejected.why: Landings since baseline is always 0; review never fires.
Fires at once on history, forbidden by criterion 4.

decisions.choice: Measure function length with syn (full) and proc-macro2 span-locations; record the call in docs/decisions.md.
decisions.reason: buy-first; exact spans, handles nested fns and impl methods.

rejected.why: Breaks on braces in strings, comments, raw strings.
Pass/fail only; no numbers for table or queue.

decisions.choice: One idempotent after_landing function called from land_pr (Landed) and from note_finished immediately after its Landed/Rejected check and before the steward tick.
decisions.reason: Both landing paths covered; dedupe makes double calls harmless; independent of steward cadence (finding 2).

decisions.choice: Test the finished-job hook in a crate-internal module code_health::hooks (in code_health.rs or a sibling test file) calling note_finished with OutcomeState::Landed and nested None; also assert a nested run and a Rejected state do not queue. code_health_hooks.rs drives only the public land_pr path.
decisions.reason: note_finished is pub(crate), unreachable from athena-cli tests.

rejected.option: Drive note_finished from the CLI integration test

decisions.choice: Hook errors become ui warnings, never failures.

rejected.why: Would report a done landing as failed.

decisions.choice: Table header built from the same width constants as rows.
decisions.reason: Aligns columns to labels; testable by offset.

files.purpose: Measurement, thresholds, queueing, baseline marker, after_landing, unit and hooks tests.
Call after_landing at end of land_pr when Landed; warn only.
Call hook in note_finished after the Landed check, before steward tick.
Only if needed to pass the finished job to the hook.
Aligned code-health table with thresholds and suite time; render test.
Integration test of the land_pr path.

steps: Add syn (full) and proc-macro2 (span-locations) to athena-core Cargo.toml; update Cargo.lock via cargo build.
Write code_health.rs constants, FileHealth, production-line count and syn longest-fn.
Add record-derived inputs: landings in window with changed files, citations, suite time.
Add queue_structural_passes with marker dedupe via Committer::commit_records.
Add design-review logic: baseline marker record, latest-review lookup, 10-landing check, self-contained High-priority text.
Add Athena::after_landing; call from land_pr (Landed) and note_finished (after Landed check, before steward tick); warn on error.
Add StatusView field and aligned table in display.rs from shared width constants.
Write unit tests, code_health::hooks tests, display test and code_health_hooks.rs.
Run cargo fmt --all --check, cargo clippy --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings, cargo test --locked.

risks.risk: Records may not list changed files per job.
risks.mitigation: Use git diff-tree on the candidate commit; count nothing if absent, with a test.

risks.risk: Hook's records commit races with landing's own writes.
risks.mitigation: Run after merge and records are done, via Committer; errors only warn.

risks.risk: syn fails to parse a file or is slow.
risks.mitigation: Parse once; list unparseable files as unmeasured.

risks.risk: Baseline marker write fails, so review never fires.
risks.mitigation: Warn; next call retries; test covers marker persistence.
Set disk minimum to 0 in new tests as 3947eb3 does.

demonstrations.method: Unit test builds a temp tree with a fixture .rs file (production code, a #[cfg(test)] mod, one long fn) and fixture records (landed jobs inside/outside 7 days, a rejected and a failed job citing the file); asserts exact numbers.
demonstrations.observes: Production lines exclude the test module; longest fn equals fixture length; weekly landings count only in-window jobs; citations count failed and rejected jobs.
demonstrations.fails_without: No cfg(test) cutoff gives a too-high count; no 7-day filter counts the old landing.

demonstrations.method: Table-driven: 2001-line file, 201-line fn, 1501 lines with 5 weekly landings, 1501 lines with 4, a small file.
demonstrations.observes: First three reported with reason; the 4-landing and small files not flagged.
demonstrations.fails_without: A removed threshold leaves its case unreported; an over-eager rule flags the clean file.

demonstrations.method: Temp git repo with records: queue after a breach; call again; call with an open request carrying the marker (control: zero requests before the first call).
demonstrations.observes: Exactly one athena.request/1 citing path, lines, longest fn, weekly landings; zero added on second call and when an open request exists.
demonstrations.fails_without: Without dedupe the second call adds a request.

demonstrations.method: Case A: 25 landed jobs, no review request: hook queues nothing but writes the baseline marker; add 9 landings: nothing; 10th: one High-priority request; then 9 more: nothing. Case B: review request then 9 landings nothing, 10th queues.
demonstrations.observes: No fire on history; fires at exactly 10 after baseline, not 9; a rerun at 10 does not double-queue.
demonstrations.fails_without: Recomputed-each-call baseline never fires (case A fails at 10th); off-by-one fails 9/10 asserts; from-zero fires at once.

demonstrations.method: Read queued review text and assert each required phrase.
demonstrations.observes: Names code-health table, files most changed and most broken since last review, open structural-pass requests, recent rejections and planning stops; asks for a short design note with proposed changes as a design-only job.
demonstrations.fails_without: Any missing item fails its phrase assert.

demonstrations.method: CLI integration test drives Athena::land_pr with the fake host/runner pattern already used in crates/athena-cli/tests/external_calls.rs and the gh.rs tests (disk minimum 0 as in 3947eb3) over a repo with an over-threshold file. Control: before land_pr no structural-pass request exists, and a non-Landed outcome queues none. Internal hooks test calls note_finished(Landed, nested None) and asserts a request; Rejected and nested queue none.
demonstrations.command: cargo test --locked -p athena-cli --test code_health_hooks && cargo test --locked -p athena-core code_health::hooks
demonstrations.observes: Request appears only after a Landed outcome, from each path.
demonstrations.fails_without: Removing the hook call from land_pr or note_finished leaves no request, so the post-landing assertion fails.

demonstrations.method: Render display::status with a StatusView holding code-health rows and suite time; assert contents and that each header label starts at the same column as its values.
demonstrations.observes: Lines, longest fn, weekly landings, citations, thresholds, over flag and suite run time present; header offsets match.
demonstrations.fails_without: Missing section or misaligned header fails the asserts.

demonstrations.method: Run cargo fmt --all --check, cargo clippy --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings, cargo test --locked; cite as run.
demonstrations.fails_without: Unformatted code, a clippy warning, or any broken behavior in criteria 1-7 fails a gate.

demonstrations.observes: CHANGELOG Unreleased has a code-health entry; decisions.md records the three thresholds, the syn-versus-hand-rolled call, and the 10-landing cadence with the baseline marker.
